subject: general
question: What is the theme for International Youth Day 2025?

options.text: Local Youth Actions for the SDGs and Beyond

solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Local Youth Actions for the SDGs and Beyond**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• International Youth Day: 12 August.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**International Youth Day** is celebrated on **August 12** every year.

 
 
• 
 
Established by the **United Nations** in **1999**.

 
 
• 
 
First observed in the year **2000**.

 
 
• 
 
Aims to **recognise** and **empower** young voices on global issues.

 
 
• 
 
2025 theme: **Local Youth Actions for the SDGs and Beyond**.
